title: Shanidar, Rawanduz & Korek Mountain
full_text:
Morning departure to visit Shanidar Cave.
Then head to Rawanduz and enjoy the natural beauty of the area.
See the famous Hamilton Road, a feat of engineering built in the early 20th century.
Continue to Korek Mountain for an overnight stay.
Take a cable car ride up Korek Mountain, while enjoying the stunning views of the surrounding landscapes.
Spend the evening relaxing in the resort.
